reviews.comment: LOVEDD THIS PROF!! He is really nice and cares about what he teaches. The class was only engaging because of the way him and Dr. Perret. You will learn a lot of new stuff.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He is very very sweet, although his lectures could get boring at times, he really cares for his students and has a lot of passion for what he teaches. If you are taking this for a required credit, you made a great choice! Very stress free course.

TRULY THE BEST PROF EVER!!!! I would take him again 100%. a few papers a few worksheets no exams and no quizzes. If you need a cultural discourse credit I would recommend taking him. He teaches with heart and truly cares about giving you feedback. Had workshop days where he would read our papers and give feedback before due date. Great Guy
Great professor, has a lot of interesting input. The class is based heavily on critical thinking.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super chill class, there's an open internet essay for the midterm and slide show project for the final. You only need to write a couple paragraphs for 6 out of the 12 in class group discussions and I got those out of the way by doing the first 6. Attendance is important, you can miss up to three with no penalty though.
Super nice, He was a D1 yapper but he was amazing, go take his class

Professor Hemmig is an amazing professor! I would 100% recommend him to anyone!! He is not a tough grader and is understanding if you need an extension on an assignment or can't attend a lecture. There is a weekly discussion used for reflection assignments that are very easy. Only 2 papers, 1 midterm exam, and a final slideshow.

I took this class as a cultural discourse credit my freshman year and had a great experience! The course doesn't have a ton of assignments so try your best on the essays and complete every assignment and you'll get an A. He's not a tough grader and gives extremely helpful feedback. I recommend Professor Hemmig and this course!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a super sweet guy and passionate about his work. The class is made up of several essays and a research paper at the end so if you don't like writing do not take his class, but if you are okay with it I would recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very nice professor, is very flexible with due dates and knows what he is talking about. The class has 3 textbooks and he tends to ramble. Textbooks are a lot to read, but you really just need to read for what you want to write about for exams (he gives topics a week before exam) and the term paper. can get an A with minimum effort
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Hemmig is a great professor and is very knowledgeable over what he is teaching! He is also very kind and understanding and always prioritizes his students as long as you communicate with him. There are a lot of reading assignments but other than that the class is pretty relaxed. Majority of your grade comes from two exams and a research paper.
